entry_updates.mechanism_append: `defaultProviderAuthContext()` creates the default environment/filesystem adapter. `env(name)` reads `globalThis.process?.env` and returns the original string only if its trimmed length is nonzero; whitespace is checked without trimming the returned value. Missing process/env or a nonstring value yields undefined. `fileExists(path)` imports `node:fs/promises` through a variable module specifier, expands any leading `~` as `homedir() + path.slice(1)`, and returns true after `fs.access` succeeds. Import, home-resolution and access failures all return false; this is an accessibility probe, not a regular-file type check. No credential file is read by this adapter (ice:packages/ai/src/auth/context.ts:11-45).
